statement: Option history for contracts that expired three or more months ago has real prints only on the expiry day; every earlier bar is a carried-forward value. Before a bulk pull of old prices, probe one bar of each kind the job needs (entry day, exit day, expiry day and not) and pull only the kinds that come back real.

statement: What an agent costs is the size of its conversation times its number of calls times the price of each read, and that price is 25 times higher (80 for the head) when the call arrives after the prompt cache has expired: 5 minutes for a subagent, one hour for the head. Measure the cost, not the tokens: wait in pieces of 240 seconds or less, replace a long-running agent before its conversation is large, and keep the head's last run of the day inside the hour.
test: After this lesson the usage line shows a cold wake by a subagent, or a day on which the daemon and the paper desk together are more than 10% of the day's usage.
